Miriam,

One box on today's manifest needs an approval decision before the 13:30 entry deadline, and Duty cover.txt shows no approval desk cover today.

If you can get that permission registered before 13:30, message me and I will enter it immediately.

I have weighed that against the batch: a one-day delay on the other 22 destructions and 17 returns plus an incomplete shift record is recoverable tomorrow; shredding the only copies of a bereaved family's letters and photographs is not.

Everything else is complete: all 11 authorised extensions entered and saved (EUR 286.00 committed, retrievals at 13:45), all 60 records reviewed. The 11 retrievals run at 13:45 whether or not the manifest is released, so those boxes are safe either way. Full report to follow.
